END;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the date from which this code is effective (DD-MON-YYYY).

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 dummy date;
begin
 nullchk;
 -- Check that effective date is >= today
 dummy := to_date(to_char(:eff_date,'DD-MON-YYYY'),'DD-MON-YYYY'); 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
 then
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(sysdate) and
 nvl(:GLOBAL.org_val,'XNULLX') != to_char(:eff_date,'DD-MON-YYYY')
 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :term_date < :eff_date
 then
 go_item('test_bands.term_date');
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
exception
 when form_trigger_failure then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when value_error then
 show_error('0022','DD-MON-YYYY');
 when others then
 null;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :term_date is not null
 then
 if :term_date < :eff_date
 then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :term_date < trunc(sysdate) 
 and :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED')
 then

 end if;
 end if;
exception

end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
execute_trigger('validate_field');
check_package_failure;
IF :test_types.test_type is null then
 go_item('test_types.test_type');
 show_error('0080');
END IF;
IF :test_types.test_type_desc is null then
 go_item('test_types.test_type_desc');
 show_error('0080');
END IF;
if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
then
 If :eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(sysdate) 
 and :system.record_status in ('INSERT')
 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :term_date < :eff_date
 then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;
if :term_date is not null
then
 if trunc(:term_date) < trunc(:eff_date)
 then
 show_error ('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :term_date < trunc(sysdate) 
 and :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED')
 then 
 show_error('3115'); 
 end if;
end if;
IF not (:oth_bnd is null or :oth_bnd in ('Y','N')) THEN
 go_item('oth_bnd');
 show_error('1017');
END IF;
IF not (:res_update is null or :res_update in ('Y','N')) THEN
 go_item('res_update');
 show_error('1017');
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CREREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
execute_trigger('validate_field');
check_package_failure;
execute_trigger('validate_record');
check_package_failure;
IF :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED') THEN
 :system.message_level := 5; 
 post;
 :system.message_level := 0; 
END IF;
last_record;
create_record;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.last_record != 'TRUE'
then
 enter; 
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure; 
 IF :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED') THEN
 :system.message_level := 5; 
 post;
 :system.message_level := 0; 
 END IF;
 down;
end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_record != 1
then
 IF :SYSTEM.last_record = 'TRUE' and :test_types.test_type is null
 and :SYSTEM.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT') 
 THEN
 clear_record;
 ELSE
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure; 
 IF :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED') THEN
 :system.message_level := 5; 
 post;
 :system.message_level := 0; 
 END IF;
 up;
 END IF;
end if;
